verdict.rationale: Filee's llms.txt calls it a free, open-source (MIT) file converter. The source is public on GitHub (KnifeLemon/Filee), with instructions for building it with the .NET 10 SDK on Windows, macOS or Linux, so users can read and build the code under a permissive license. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the LICENSE file in the repository, independent or hands-on corroboration of the license terms.
